abstract: Possible protective effects of D-Tryptophan-6 luteinizing hormone releasing hormone (D-Trp-6-LH-RH) against irradiation-induced testicular damage were investigated for the first time in patients with seminoma. After unilateral orchiectomy 12 men were allocated to receive the long-acting gonadotropin releasing hormone (GnRH) agonist D-Trp-6-LH-RH prior to and for the duration of radiotherapy. Eight patients with the same disease served as a control group. In contrast to several trials to protect spermatogenesis from chemotherapy by GnRH agonists, we first suppressed the pituitary-testicular axis before starting the treatment. As a new schedule this adjuvant GnRH agonist treatment was combined with cyproterone acetate for the first 20 days to diminish the amount and the duration of the initial stimulation of gonadotropins and testosterone. Irradiation started after suppression of the pituitary-gonadal axis. In all patients luteinizing hormone and testosterone were completely suppressed throughout the treatment compared to the controls, whereas the initial suppression of follicle-stimulating hormone was not completely maintained until radiotherapy was completed. At the follow-up at 18 months after completion of therapy, all patients reached their initial concentration of gonadotropins, testosterone, and motile spermatozoa independently of D-Trp-6-LH-RH treatment. With the dose and schedule investigated, the GnRH agonist showed no protective effects against testicular damage caused by radiotherapy.
abstract_ja: 放射線療法による精巣障害からの精子形成の保護について、D-トリプトファン-6黄体形成ホルモン放出ホルモン（D-Trp-6-LH-RH）の効果をセミノーマ患者で初めて検討した。片側精巣摘除術後の男性12名に、放射線療法の前から照射期間を通じて長時間作用型GnRHアゴニストD-Trp-6-LH-RHを投与した。同一疾患の8名を対照群とした。化学療法による精子形成障害をGnRHアゴニストで防ぐ従来の試みとは異なり、本研究では照射開始前に下垂体-精巣系を抑制した。新しい投与法として、本治療にはゴナドトロピンとテストステロンの初期上昇を抑えるため、最初の20日間シプロテロン酢酸エステルを併用した。照射は下垂体-性腺系の抑制後に開始した。全症例で、治療期間を通じて黄体形成ホルモンとテストステロンは対照群と比較して完全に抑制された。一方、卵胞刺激ホルモンの初期抑制は放射線療法終了まで完全には維持されなかった。フォローアップ時点（治療終了後18か月）で、D-Trp-6-LH-RHによる治療の有無にかかわらず、全症例でゴナドトロピン、テストステロンおよび運動精子の値は初期濃度に回復した。検討した用量・投与法では、GnRHアゴニストは放射線療法による精巣障害に対する保護効果を示さなかった。
